headline.text: Stress variant: long-form narrative keeps hierarchy intact

body.text: This extended paragraph intentionally pushes line length and sentence complexity to verify that the two-column editorial system remains readable across narrow phones, medium tablets, and wider desktop widths without clipped copy, awkward balancing, or loss of narrative order when the layout collapses.

pull-quote.text: "When collapsed, story still reads first, context second."

support.text: Footnotes, legal caveats, and references remain visible but secondary, preserving scan rhythm and editorial intent.
